title: 第1章 妖魔邪祟的世界第2章 嫂嫂身上有宝箱
slug: 从基础刀法开始肝熟练度
lines: 说完，将旁边准备好的红泥均匀的涂抹在了木桶之上，四周也点起了火。
前一秒，梦里的池屹还在满目柔情向她表达爱意，恨不得将这辈子所有的情话都讲完，可一睁眼，梦境破碎。
后面的拍品，林九棉已经不在乎了，拿到了桃木剑后，便推着凤水寒离开了。
“对，那个拿上，简易担架，还有裹尸袋。”
莫默收集着顾楚楚需要的东西。
如同一只猎豹般在朱韬转身的刹那冲到他的身后，扑倒、反剪双手膝盖压在脖子处。
吴鸿煊这个奸猾的家伙，看到黄炳耀心情高兴，心思一转，就开始拍起马屁来了。
“这些也是我给孩子们买的，一点心意。”
古羽赶忙将自己带来的东西放在了木桌上。
“家里虽然没佣人，但您以后若是有什么需要，告诉我们一声就行。”
柳如汐也微笑着点了点头。
可这时对面那位吴sir的下一句话，彻底让林过云感到，深入骨髓般的害怕与胆怯。
曹操正慌忙跑之间，正南上一队军队到，于是夏侯领兵来救援，截停吕布大战。
在黄昏时分，大雨，各自率领军队分散。
曹操回寨，重赏典韦，加任领军都尉。
当新来的雇佣兵和冒险者们打探清楚的时候，他们才知道眼前的遗迹竟然已经彻底被封闭起来了，而很显然他们是再也没有办法进去了。
“大胆畜生，光天化日之下，朗朗乾坤之中，你居然胆敢妄想伤人性命。
畜生！
吃我一剑！”
薛仁贵喊道。
“哈哈哈，翼德兄弟好功夫。
我们去找那张梁贼人。”
李宏和周青也不恼怒。
桐乃感觉肩膀被轻轻的拍了两下，本就刚刚放松下来，心里没什么防备，这下瞬间就吓得一蹦三尺高。
接着，四人又开始在秘境之外布置法阵，以秘境通道为中心，方圆十万丈范围都在法阵之内，布置这座法阵，仇老从一开始就没有停下过，因为这将是他有生之年，所布置的最强大的法阵。
苏九知道那个正在消失的人影就是唐婷的灵魂，等到她完全消失的时候，这场夺舍也就成功了。
听到这话，伊犁城主神色一喜，刚要说话，就看见苏九摆了摆手，当下伊犁城主对苏九行了一礼，转身离去了。
若是平时，对外人极为礼貌的桐乃或许不会说什么，但此时，本就心烦意乱，焦躁无比的她被盯了半天火气莫名的就嘭嘭嘭的往上窜。
妮娜的姐姐伊娜已经忘了这是在演戏，她慌张的从暗影中冲出来想要营救她的妹妹。
可是蓝龙海迪亚毫不费力的也抓住了她，他将她们姐妹俩一同塞进了嘴巴里，嚼了几下，咽入腹中。
元宗谅这段剑气虽不足以制止住那九尺钢索的反弹，但却也总算抵消了其中不少力道，如此，静思这才得以免受其伤。

After saying that, he spread the red mud prepared nearby evenly on the barrel, and lit a fire around it.
One second ago, Chi Yi in the dream was still expressing his love to her with tenderness in his eyes. He wished he could finish all the love words in his life, but as soon as he opened his eyes, the dream was shattered.
Lin Jiumian no longer cared about the following items. After getting the peach wood sword, he pushed Feng Shuihan and left.
"Yes, take that, a simple stretcher and a body bag."
Mo Mo collected what Gu Chuchu needed.
Like a cheetah, it rushed behind Zhu Tao the moment he turned around, threw him down, and pressed his hands and knees on his neck.
Wu Hongxuan, a cunning guy, saw Huang Bingyao in a happy mood, and as soon as his mind changed, he started to flatter him.
"I bought these for my children as well, with a little thought."
Gu Yu quickly put the things he brought on the wooden table.
"Although there are no servants at home, if you need anything in the future, just let us know."
Liu Ruxi also smiled and nodded.
But at this moment, the next words from Sir Wu opposite him made Lin Guoyun feel fear and timidity that penetrated his bones.
While Cao Cao was running in a hurry, a group of troops arrived from the south, so Xiahou led his troops to rescue and stopped Lu Bu's battle.
At dusk, it rained heavily, and each led his troops to disperse.
Cao Cao returned to the stronghold, rewarded Dian Wei heavily and was appointed captain of the army.
When the new mercenaries and adventurers inquired about it, they realized that the ruins in front of them had been completely sealed, and it was obvious that they would no longer be able to enter.
"Bold beast, in broad daylight, in the clear sky, you actually dare to think about hurting people's lives.
Beast!
Eat my sword! "
Xue Rengui shouted.
"Hahaha, brother Yide is so good at it.
Let's go find the traitor Zhang Liang. "
Li Hong and Zhou Qing were not angry either.
Kirino felt two gentle taps on her shoulders. She had just relaxed and had no defense in her heart. Now she was so frightened that she jumped three feet high.
Then, the four people began to arrange the magic circle outside the secret realm, with the secret realm passage as the center, and a radius of 100,000 feet within the magic circle. When arranging this magic circle, Qiu Lao never stopped from the beginning, because this will be the most powerful magic circle he has ever deployed in his lifetime.
Su Jiu knew that the disappearing figure was Tang Ting's soul. When she disappeared completely, the body snatching was successful.
Hearing this, the Yili City Lord looked happy. Just as he was about to speak, he saw Su Jiu waving his hand. At that moment, the Yili City Lord saluted Su Jiu and turned around to leave.
Normally, Kirino, who was extremely polite to outsiders, might not say anything, but at this time, she was already upset and anxious. She was stared at for a long time, and her anger was rising inexplicably.
Nina's sister Ina had forgotten that this was an act, and she rushed out of the shadows in a panic to rescue her sister.
But the blue dragon Hydia caught her effortlessly. He stuffed the two sisters into his mouth, chewed them a few times, and swallowed them.
Although Yuan Zongliang's sword energy was not enough to stop the rebound of the nine-foot steel cable, it was able to offset a lot of the force. In this way, Jingsi was able to avoid being hurt.
